title: Bengoshi no hisho: Okudashide ikasete
original_title: 弁護士の秘書 奥出しイカせて
overview: Sakisaka and Hamada are senior and junior alumni of the same university's law faculty, and now work as lawyers at "Sakisaka Law Office." Sakisaka couldn't feel any authority over Hamada, who, unlike him, passed the bar exam on his first try and even appeared on television as a celebrity. One day, both men fell in love at first sight with Ruiko, who had started working as a secretary...
